original_question: For a first-countable well-filtered space X, do the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology on K(X), the set of nonempty compact saturated subsets of X, coincide?
target_in_paper: Question 6.13 in Section 6 ("Smyth power spaces"): "For a first-countable well-filtered space X, does the upper Vietoris topology and the Scott topology on K(X) coincide?"
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the paper's target almost verbatim. It has the correct hypothesis (a first-countable well-filtered space X), the correct object K(X), and the correct comparison (upper Vietoris topology versus Scott topology). It also correctly identifies K(X) as the family of nonempty compact saturated subsets of X.
missing_details: To make the Scott topology unambiguous, K(X) should be viewed as the poset equipped with the Smyth preorder / reverse inclusion order: K1 ≤ K2 iff K2 ⊆ K1.
To make the upper Vietoris topology self-contained, specify that it is generated by the basic opens □U = {K in K(X) : K ⊆ U} for U open in X.
The quantifier is universal: the question asks whether this coincidence holds for every first-countable well-filtered space X, with no extra hypotheses.

No additional assumptions from the preceding partial results should be inserted: in particular, the paper does not assume PS(X) is first-countable or that min(K) is countable for each K in K(X) when stating the open question.
refined_question: For every first-countable well-filtered space X, let K(X) be the poset of all nonempty compact saturated subsets of X ordered by reverse inclusion (K1 ≤ K2 iff K2 ⊆ K1). Is the Scott topology on K(X) equal to the upper Vietoris topology generated by the basic opens □U = {K in K(X) : K ⊆ U}, where U ranges over the open subsets of X?
justification: The draft is aiming exactly at Question 6.13 in Section 6. Section 2 fixes the notation K(X), the Smyth/reverse-inclusion order, the upper Vietoris topology, and the Smyth power space PS(X). Section 6 then builds to Question 6.13 through Proposition 6.9, Corollary 6.10, Theorem 6.8, Theorem 6.11, and Corollary 6.12: the paper records several sufficient conditions under which the upper Vietoris and Scott topologies on K(X) agree, and then asks whether first-countability of X together with well-filteredness already suffices. The only real omissions in the draft are the underlying order on K(X) needed to define the Scott topology and the explicit basis description of the upper Vietoris topology.
